name: @cocreate/utils
description: A simple utils component in vanilla javascript. Easily configured using HTML5 attributes and/or JavaScript API.

interface.summary: A simple utils component in vanilla javascript. Easily configured using HTML5 attributes and/or JavaScript API.

attributes.name: key | {prefix}-key
attributes.role: Names the property read or written by getData and setData.

attributes.name: get-data | {prefix}-get-data
attributes.role: When false, excludes the element from getData collection.

attributes.name: set-data | {prefix}-set-data
attributes.role: When false, excludes the element from setData mapping.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Collects values from elements with key or {prefix}-key and converts dotted keys into nested objects.

methods.name: encodeContent
methods.signature: encodeContent({ value, contentType?, pathname?, encoding?, format?, charset?, fatal? })
methods.description: Prepares UTF-8 text or encoded binary for JSON transport and storage; Blob/File inputs return a Promise.

methods.name: decodeContent
methods.signature: decodeContent({ value, contentType?, pathname?, encoding?, format?, charset?, fatal? })
methods.description: Restores text, Uint8Array bytes, or an ArrayBuffer for HTTP responses, file writes, and binary storage; Blob/File inputs return a Promise.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.signature: getContentType({ contentType?, value?, extension?, pathname?, fallback? })
methods.description: Resolves a MIME type from explicit metadata, a data URL, a Blob/File, an extension, or a pathname.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Returns the preferred filename extension for a MIME type, or a configurable fallback.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Returns all known extensions for a MIME type, preferred first; unknown types return an empty array.

methods.name: isTextContentType
methods.description: Classifies a MIME type using registry flags and textual MIME families.
